subject: Pilot readiness: ClearPath AI evaluation sprint & acceptance matrix
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Novak <elena@clearpath.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-10T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot readiness: ClearPath AI evaluation sprint & acceptance matrix

Hi Elena — thanks again for the conversation earlier. Quick post-call recap and a proposed 3-week evaluation sprint so we can validate performance, cost, and quality for the Summarize+QA flows you described. Please review and confirm.

High-level goal:
- Validate Redwood inference for ClearPath’s document summarization pipeline at production-like scale and measure latency, throughput, token cost, and label-level quality.

Proposed sprint (three weeks):
1) Week 0 (prep, 3 business days): dataset drop, access to a small representative subset (~5k docs), test account + IP allowlist, and security contact.
2) Week 1 (baseline tests): smoke benchmarks — p50/p95 latency, baseline throughput at 1,5,15 RPS, tokenized cost estimate.
3) Week 2 (stress & scenario tests): scaled concurrency runs, burst patterns, and representative prompt mixes.
4) Week 3 (quality & acceptance): run labeled eval set, human review sampling, and lock acceptance metrics.

Proposed success criteria (acceptance gates):
- Latency: p50 <= 120 ms, p95 <= 320 ms (for the 1–2k token prompts you shared).
- Throughput: sustain 12–15 req/s for the canonical end-to-end request under 95% of runs.
- Cost: modeled token cost <= $0.0009/token (we’ll refine with exact quantization profile).
- Quality: automated eval pass rate >= 90% on labeled dev set AND human-rated helpfulness >= 4.1/5 on a 50-sample audit.
- Observability: traceable request IDs, per-request token breakdown, and KV-cache hit-rate report available.

Owners (redwood):
- Technical lead / test runner: Marissa Cole (marissa_cole@redwood.ai)
- Cost/quantization owner: Ben Carter (ben_carter@redwood.ai)

Requests for ClearPath to unblock prep:
- Drop: 5k-sample eval dataset (anonymized) + 150 labeled examples for the quality gate (CSV preferred).
- IP allowlist and preferred region (us-west).
- Contact for procurement/security to exchange SOW and SOC2 evidence (pdf).

Attachments: clearpath-mop-v1.pdf (pilot scope), poc-success-metrics.xlsx (detailed KPI workbook).

If this looks good I’ll schedule the kickoff for Monday (May 18) and book a 30m tech sync. Next steps if you confirm: we’ll spin a trial environment and share a short-run baseline report within 5 business days.

Thanks,
Aditya
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Cell: +1 415-555-0146

From: Elena Novak <elena@clearpath.ai>

Date: 2026-05-11T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot readiness: ClearPath AI evaluation sprint & acceptance matrix

Hi Aditya — thanks for the clean summary. This aligns with internal expectations. A few clarifications:

1) Dataset: we can provide the anonymized 5k sample and the 150 labeled examples by end of day Wednesday (May 13).
2) Quality metric: our internal stake is more on "entity preservation" and correctness for the QA follow-up; can we add an entity-preservation metric (precision/recall target >= 88%) to the acceptance gates?
3) Procurement: I looped in procurement; we will need a short SOW and an NDA addendum for the pilot.

Procurement (procurement@clearpath.ai) — please advise on the SOW cadence and any PO process.

Also, we prefer kicks in the US-WEST region.

Elena
Head of ML Product, ClearPath AI

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Novak <elena@clearpath.ai>
Date: 2026-05-12T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot readiness: ClearPath AI evaluation sprint & acceptance matrix

Thanks — quick internal note and operational checklist before kickoff.

Marissa here — I’ll drive the runbook and the baseline report. Ben, can you confirm the quantization profile and per-token cost projection by tomorrow? I’ll prepare the instrumentation plan.

Operational checklist (owners / items):
- Data intake + schema validation (owner: Elena / ClearPath) — expected by 2026-05-13 EOD.
- Trial environment (owner: Marissa) — provisioned in us-west, with IP allowlist by 2026-05-14.
- Baseline benchmarks (owner: Marissa) — p50/p95, cold vs warm cache numbers, KV hit-rate.
- Throughput stress harness (owner: Ben) — concurrency profiles 1/5/15/30 RPS, artifact: JMeter/locust scripts.
- Cost model (owner: Ben) — tokenized cost breakdown, projected per 1M tokens.
- Quality evaluation (owner: Aditya + ClearPath) — run labeled eval and human review. Define scoring rubric (entity preservation: precision/recall).

Instrumentation we require from ClearPath (minimum):
- Correlation ID per request (traceable to your logging),
- Sampled request/response pairs (redacted) for human audit,
- Known failure example set (if any).

I’ll add the acceptance matrix rows to the shared KPI spreadsheet and set up the Drive folder. Once Ben confirms the cost projection and quant profile, we’ll lock the success numbers in the SOW.

Marissa Cole
Staff SRE, Redwood Inference

Attachment: poc-success-metrics.xlsx (updated with entity preservation row to add)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, ClearPath AI Procurement <procurement@clearpath.ai>
Date: 2026-05-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot readiness: ClearPath AI evaluation sprint & acceptance matrix

Elena / team — great, thanks for the quick turnaround. Finalized summary and immediate next steps below (we’ll treat this as the agreement to proceed unless procurement flags the SOW):

Locked acceptance gates (final):
- Latency: p50 <= 120 ms, p95 <= 320 ms (measured on real traffic mix).
- Throughput: sustain >= 12 req/s for canonical 95% window.
- Cost: modeled <= $0.0009/token (Ben to confirm exact after quantization).
- Quality: labeled eval pass >= 90%; entity preservation precision >= 88% and recall >= 86%; human audit mean >= 4.1/5 on sample of 50.
- Observability: correlation IDs present, per-request token breakdown, KV hit-rate > 0.7 for warmed profiles.

Timeline (target dates):
- 2026-05-13: ClearPath delivers dataset + labeled examples (ETA confirmed).
- 2026-05-14: Redwood provisions trial environment in us-west + IP allowlist.
- 2026-05-15 to 2026-05-19: Baseline + stress runs (report snapshot by 2026-05-20).
- 2026-05-20 to 2026-05-26: Quality audits and human review; final acceptance check on 2026-05-26.

Owners (final):
- Redwood technical lead / runbook: Marissa Cole (marissa_cole@redwood.ai)
- Redwood cost & quantization: Ben Carter (ben_carter@redwood.ai)
- ClearPath data & quality lead: Elena Novak (elena@clearpath.ai)
- Redwood account exec / commercial: Aditya Rao (aditya@redwood.ai)

Immediate asks from ClearPath (action items):
1) Dataset drop to shared Drive link + sample labeling rubric by EOD 2026-05-13.
2) Confirm the preferred IP addresses to allowlist.
3) Procurement: please send SOW/PO instructions and any required SSO/contracting forms.

If everyone is aligned I’ll send a calendar invite for the technical kickoff (30m) for Monday May 18 at 10:00 AM PT.

Thanks all — excited to get this started.

Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0146
